import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

source = Path.cwd()
branch = (source / 'scripts/gkeyll-branch').read_text().strip()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='postgkyl-branch-check-') as directory:
    root = Path(directory)
    upstream = root / 'upstream'
    upstream.mkdir()
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env.update(GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL='/dev/null', GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM='1',
               GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='Build test', GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL='test@example.invalid',
               GIT_COMMITTER_NAME='Build test', GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL='test@example.invalid',
               GIT_CONFIG_COUNT='2', GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0='core.hooksPath',
               GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0='/dev/null',
               GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=f'url.{upstream.as_uri()}.insteadOf',
               GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1='https://github.com/ammarhakim/gkeyll.git')

    def git(repo, *args):
        return subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(repo), *args], env=env,
                              check=True, text=True, capture_output=True).stdout.strip()

    git(upstream, 'init', '-b', branch)
    git(upstream, 'config', 'uploadpack.allowFilter', 'true')
    (upstream / 'configure').write_text('#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n')
    (upstream / 'configure').chmod(0o755)
    (upstream / 'Makefile').write_text('core:\n\tmkdir -p build/core\n\tcp answer build/core/libg0core.so\n')
    (upstream / '.gitignore').write_text('build/\n')
    (upstream / 'answer').write_text('initial\n')
    git(upstream, 'add', '.')
    git(upstream, 'commit', '-m', 'Initial fixture')

    checkout = root / 'postgkyl'
    scripts = checkout / 'scripts'
    scripts.mkdir(parents=True)
    for name in ['build_gkeyll.sh', 'gkeyll-branch']:
        shutil.copy2(source / 'scripts' / name, scripts / name)
    (scripts / 'build_gpython.sh').write_text('#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n')
    producer = checkout / 'gkeyll'

    def build(success=True, message=None):
        result = subprocess.run(['sh', str(scripts / 'build_gkeyll.sh')], cwd=checkout,
                                env=env, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=30)
        assert (result.returncode == 0) == success, result.stdout + result.stderr
        if message:
            assert message in result.stderr, result.stderr
        if success:
            assert git(producer, 'branch', '--show-current') == branch
            assert git(producer, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD') == git(upstream, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD')
            assert (producer / 'build/core/libg0core.so').read_text() == (upstream / 'answer').read_text()
            assert (scripts / 'gkeyll-branch').read_text() == branch + '\n'
            assert not (scripts / 'gkeyll-revision').exists()

    build()
    assert git(producer, 'rev-parse', '--is-shallow-repository') == 'true'
    print('PASS: fresh shallow clone builds the configured branch')

    for index in range(2):
        (upstream / 'answer').write_text(f'upstream update {index}\n')
        git(upstream, 'commit', '-am', f'Update {index}')
    build()
    print('PASS: repeat build advances across multiple upstream commits')

    git(producer, 'checkout', '--detach')
    git(producer, 'branch', '-D', branch)
    build()
    print('PASS: existing detached checkout moves onto the branch')

    for staged in [False, True]:
        (producer / 'answer').write_text('local work\n')
        if staged:
            git(producer, 'add', 'answer')
        before = git(producer, 'status', '--porcelain')
        build(False, 'has tracked modifications')
        assert git(producer, 'status', '--porcelain') == before
        assert (producer / 'answer').read_text() == 'local work\n'
    print('PASS: unstaged and staged local edits are preserved and refused')

    git(producer, 'commit', '-m', 'Local work')
    local_head = git(producer, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD')
    build(False, 'has local commits')
    assert git(producer, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD') == local_head
    print('PASS: local commits are preserved and not built as the remote tip')

    (upstream / 'answer').write_text('diverging upstream\n')
    git(upstream, 'commit', '-am', 'Diverge')
    build(False)
    assert git(producer, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD') == local_head
    assert (producer / 'answer').read_text() == 'local work\n'
    print('PASS: divergent branch histories fail without dropping local commits')
PY",workdir:"/home/maxwell-rosen/postgkyl",yield_time_ms:1000,max_output_tokens:5000}));
